prompt: During an 8-hour shift, Mrs. Chen takes 240 mL coffee, 180 mL juice, 240 mL broth, 120 mL gelatin, a serving of mashed potatoes, and a 400 mL cup of ice chips. She voids 650 mL. What total intake should PCT Dana record?

options.text: 780 mL total
860 mL total
980 mL total
1,180 mL total

explanation: Intake counts every fluid and every food that is liquid at room temperature, and ice chips are recorded at half their volume. 240 + 180 + 240 + 120 (gelatin) + 200 (400 ÷ 2 for ice chips) = 980 mL. Mashed potatoes are solid food, and the 650 mL void goes in the output column.

distractorExplanations.a: Leaves out the ice chips entirely; ice chips are fluid intake, recorded at half their volume (400 mL of chips = 200 mL).
distractorExplanations.b: Leaves out the gelatin; gelatin, ice cream, and popsicles turn liquid at room temperature and count as fluid intake.
distractorExplanations.d: Records the ice chips at their full 400 mL; melted chips yield roughly half that volume, so only 200 mL is recorded.
